mapper.sql: p.*, u.name AS owner_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_members m WHERE m.project_id=p.id) AS member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_tasks t WHERE t.project_id=p.id) AS task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_tasks t WHERE t.project_id=p.id AND t.status='DONE') AS done_task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_tasks t WHERE t.project_id=p.id AND t.status!='DONE' AND t.due_date < #{today}) AS overdue_task_count, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.progress)) FROM project_tasks t WHERE t.project_id=p.id),0) AS progress
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM projects p JOIN users u ON u.id=p.owner_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_members m WHERE m.project_id=p.id AND m.user_id=#{userId})
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%'))
ORDER BY FIELD(p.status,'ACTIVE','COMPLETED','ARCHIVED'), p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC
SELECT FROM projects p JOIN users u ON u.id=p.owner_id WHERE p.id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_members m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.user_id=#{userId} AND u.active=TRUE
SELECT u.id AS user_id,u.name,u.team_id,t.name AS team_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id=u.team_id WHERE u.active=TRUE ORDER BY u.name,u.id

SELECT u.id AS user_id,u.name,u.team_id,t.name AS team_name FROM project_members m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id=u.team_id WHERE m.project_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY u.name,u.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_members WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_tasks t WHERE t.project_id=#{projectId} AND (t.assignee_id=#{userId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_task_collaborators c WHERE c.task_id=t.id AND c.user_id=#{userId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_task_handovers h WHERE h.task_id=t.id AND h.status='PENDING' AND (h.to_user_id=#{userId} OR h.from_user_id=#{userId})))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_task_handovers h JOIN project_tasks t ON t.id=h.task_id WHERE t.project_id=#{projectId} AND h.status='PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_tasks WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND status!='DONE'
SELECT t.*,u.name AS assignee_name FROM project_tasks t JOIN users u ON u.id=t.assignee_id WHERE t.project_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC
SELECT t.*,u.name AS assignee_name FROM project_tasks t JOIN users u ON u.id=t.assignee_id WHERE t.id=#{taskId}
SELECT * FROM project_tasks WHERE id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE project_tasks SET title=#{title},description=#{description},status=#{status},progress=#{progress},due_date=#{dueDate}, updated_at=#{updatedAt},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id,u.name,u.team_id,t.name AS team_name FROM project_task_collaborators c JOIN users u ON u.id=c.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id=u.team_id WHERE c.task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY u.name,u.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_task_collaborators WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT * FROM project_task_checklist WHERE task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM project_task_checklist WHERE id=#{itemId}
mapper.update: UPDATE project_task_checklist SET completed=#{completed} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.*,u.name AS user_name FROM project_task_comments c JOIN users u ON u.id=c.user_id WHERE c.task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT e.*,u.name AS uploaded_by_name FROM project_task_evidence e JOIN users u ON u.id=e.uploaded_by WHERE e.task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY e.id DESC
SELECT * FROM project_task_evidence WHERE id=#{id}
